name: Dumbbell floor press
summary: Lying press with the floor limiting the range; friendly to the shoulders.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold the dumbbell over the chest with a straight arm.
Lower until the upper arm touches the floor, elbow about 45° from the body.
Press back up to a straight arm.
commonMistakes: Bouncing the elbow off the floor.
breathing: Inhale while lowering, exhale while pressing.
easier: Use both hands on the dumbbell.
harder: One arm with a slow lowering and a pause.

start.alt: Lying on the back, elbow on the floor, dumbbell above the shoulder.

end.alt: Lying on the back, arm straight above the chest holding the dumbbell.
